title: GB28181 Ingress
description: Configure this box as a GB/T 28181 SIP server (UAS): identity, media port pool and device allowlist, plus live runtime counters.

runtime.desc: What this process actually loaded, with live counters. Restart the service when it differs from the target configuration.

detail.configUnreadable: The saved configuration could not be read at startup; defaults are in use
detail.mediaAddressUnresolvable: Could not derive an advertised media address: check the interfaces or set one explicitly
detail.configInvalid: The saved configuration failed validation; the SIP listener was not started
detail.ingressStopFailed: SIP listener reported an error while stopping

config.desc: Saving only writes the target configuration; the SIP listener and media port pool switch over after a restart.
config.loadError: Failed to read the GB28181 configuration
config.restartRequiredDesc: This process still runs the parameters it loaded at startup. Restart Zhulong before the new configuration takes over the SIP listener and media port pool.
config.enabledDesc: When disabled no SIP port is bound; the remaining saved fields are kept.
config.sipIdDesc: This box's identity in the GB28181 domain. Letters, digits and . - _ only.
config.sipRealmPlaceholder: Empty uses the SIP server ID
config.sipRealmDesc: Single-box deployments usually leave this empty: devices authenticate against this box's own identity.
config.sipListenDesc: Formatted as 0.0.0.0:5060. Binding a port below 1024 requires the matching privilege.
config.sipTransportDesc: UDP is the common default for domestic devices; TCP serves devices that only support TCP.
config.mediaBindAddressDesc: Local bind address of the RTP/RTCP sockets.
config.mediaAdvertisedIpDesc: Address written into SDP that devices must reach. Empty lets the server derive the single non-loopback IPv4; behind NAT you must set it explicitly.
config.portSpanHint: This range supports {{count}} concurrent sessions (RTP/RTCP are leased as a pair of 2 ports).
config.fixedDesc: P0 implements the standard profile only (signalling + Digest auth + cleartext media). GB 35114 A/B/C and the 2022 high-security profile are not implemented; devices that were not provisioned are rejected.

devices.desc: Only devices provisioned with a Digest password can register; the password is stored encrypted and never echoed back.
devices.dialogDesc: Register a national device ID with its Digest password, or rotate existing credentials.
devices.searchPlaceholder: Filter by device ID or name
devices.emptyDesc: Provision the device ID and Digest password before the device registers, otherwise registration is refused.
devices.filterEmptyDesc: Adjust the filters or clear the search term.
devices.loadError: Failed to read the device allowlist

form.deviceIdDesc: 20 decimal digits; it cannot change once provisioned.
form.name: Device name
form.nameDesc: For operator recognition only; empty shows the device ID.
form.passwordKeepPlaceholder: Leave empty to keep the current password
form.passwordDesc: Stored encrypted; it is never echoed back after saving.
form.passwordKeepHint: Leave empty to keep the stored password — credentials are not cleared.
form.transportDesc: SIP transport used for this device's registration and downstream commands.
form.expiresDesc: The device must re-register within this period, 60–86400.

validation.sipIdRequired: A SIP server ID is required while enabled
validation.identityCharset: Only letters, digits and . - _ are allowed
validation.listenRequired: A SIP listen address is required while enabled
validation.listenPortRange: The listen port must be within 1–65535
validation.bindAddressRequired: A media bind address is required while enabled
validation.portOrder: The range start must not exceed the range end
validation.portSpan: The range must hold at least one RTP/RTCP pair (2 ports)
validation.deviceIdFormat: The device ID must be exactly 20 digits
validation.deviceNameMax: The name must not exceed {{max}} characters
validation.passwordMax: The password must not exceed {{max}} characters
validation.passwordRequired: A new device needs a Digest password
validation.expiresRange: The lease must be within {{min}}–{{max}} seconds
